entities.name: Query UbiE methyltransferase
observations: 242 aa protein; estimated molecular mass 26.6 kDa and theoretical pI 8.67.
Contains the Pfam Ubie_methyltran domain PF01209.25 across residues 16–241, with additional methyltransferase-family matches.
Shares 67.8% identity over 100% query and target coverage with reviewed UbiE Q9X3X2 from Zymomonas mobilis.
Homology-supported function is S-adenosyl-L-methionine-dependent C-methylation in ubiquinone and/or menaquinone biosynthesis.
No transmembrane segment or obvious signal peptide is indicated by the reported sequence features; a soluble intracellular enzyme is favored.
Exact substrate usage cannot be established from sequence alone because UbiE homologs may participate in ubiquinone biosynthesis, menaquinone biosynthesis, or both.

entities.name: UbiE Q9X3X2
observations: Reviewed UniProt reference from Zymomonas mobilis; 67.8% identical to the query over the full sequence.
Catalytic activities are EC 2.1.1.163 and EC 2.1.1.201, using S-adenosyl-L-methionine as methyl donor.

entities.name: Quinone biosynthesis
observations: UbiE homologs catalyze a methylation step in menaquinone biosynthesis and a related methylation step in ubiquinone biosynthesis.
The reported reactions release S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine and proton.
